name: The Answer is Chicken
source:
A micro visual novel about street markets, small talk, and one man's belief that chicken solves everything.

You're new in town. First stop: the market. First person you meet: TJ — hype man,  and the most enthusiastic chicken salesman you'll ever meet.

Tell him what you need — food, a gift for your mother, something to kill boredom, or nothing at all — and watch every single conversation circle back to chicken. 

[From [url=https://lilalove.itch.io/the-answer-is-chicken]itch.io[/url]]
